submitted.rationale: Index 12 (Co0.57Sb0.43) had the highest measured EQE, 0.021%. Index 6 (Co-rich) measured 0.0021% and index 19 (near CoSb2O6 stoichiometry) measured about 0%, so merit peaks at intermediate composition. XRD shows the same rutile-type phase at indices 0, 6, 9 and 12, so the maximum likely comes from a composition or defect effect rather than a phase change.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE about 0% (-1e-4%), even though it sits near trirutile CoSb2O6 stoichiometry
EQE fell from index 12 to index 6. Index 0 only differs in XRD by weak extra low-Q peaks.
